clue.text: Convention competently handles failure, on reflection

indicators.note: to handle is to hold, so the first word holds the second inside it

parts.note: doing something competently is doing it ably

indicators.note: a reflection shows a thing back to front, so the word for failure is read backwards

parts.note: a mess is a botched job, a failure

explanation.surface: A conference manages a setback well when people look back on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'handles' reads like managing a problem, but it means holding: the competent word grips the backward failure.
explanation.definitionFit: A convention is a formal gathering of delegates, which is a synonym for a gathered meeting body.

indicators.note: restricting means hemming in, so the law word encloses the mushroom

clue.text: One poorly formed arrangement to make easy profits
